propositions: Full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s; --filter=blob:none reduces to 68.7 MiB / 14.3s (~15x improvement) while preserving commit ancestry needed for merge-base and era-scoping
When tickets fetch times out in CI, rebar silently bootstraps an orphan branch via worktree add, creating an empty divergent store where all reads return [] and writes cannot fast-forward to origin
Partial blob:none clone is safe for rebar verify-identity and blame operations because commit graph is complete and blob bodies are read from working tree, not lazy-fetched
The fail-open bootstrap mechanism must be replaced with fail-closed behavior that exits non-zero when remote is reachable but fetch fails, preventing silent divergence

Gerrit verify-identity job in gerrit-verify.yaml performs full-history fetch (6.73m of 7.3m total job) with complete commit graph needed for enforce_since scoping, which blob:none preserves while reducing transfer by 64x
.bridge_state merge conflicts require merge.ours.driver=true on the runner before partial clone is enabled to prevent silent 3-way text merge of 18 MB JSON file
